direction_freeze.rule: for each factor-horizon, development 2016-2021 HAC p-value; BH across 32 tests; freeze sign only when q<0.05

portfolio.exit: close on Hth market trading day
portfolio.long_only_reverse_signal: LOW direction means buy lowest raw factor values; no short selling

limitations: 2024+ has appeared in prior SSO research; it is not a pristine unseen holdout.
Historical point-in-time universe, delisted securities and survivorship bias still require audit.
Minimum commission, bid-ask spread, price-limit queue, partial fills and order-book depth are not modelled.
No official turnover amount; volume factor remains raw-share-volume anomaly.
Daily signal cohorts are not a fully compounded capital-account backtest; TopN cohort overlap is not netted.
Factor direction is frozen per factor-horizon from development period only; unresolved pairs are not promoted or reoriented using later periods.
